description: P3 consumer-assertion + core-detection pin for CHECK 14 (no turn-terminating language in sub-step skill body prose, issue #321). A skill body loads into its CALLING AGENT's context, so caller-scoped terminal prose makes an agent that invokes the skill inline end its turn early and return the skill's output as its own — a silent false PASS. The set_check pins the detection semantics against a sample body: every terminal phrase is captured, and the `stop-and-merge` domain term is NOT captured (the check strips it as a KEEP phrase; the fixture regex mirrors that with a negative lookahead). The consumers pin the load-bearing literals proving the check exists and keeps its contract: the `=== CHECK 14:` section header, `add_finding 'CHECK14'` (it emits CHECK14 findings), the caller-derived discovery that excludes overlord.md, and the fail-closed empty-derived-set finding (an empty set must never silently pass).

set_check.extract_regex: (Your final action|final action is a|[Pp]roduce zero (?:text|chat)|^Emit exactly|and stop(?!-and-merge))

consumers.pattern: derived an EMPTY set from non-overlord agent bodies
